title: Bufalin alleviates myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury by targeting PTGR2 to regulate NF-kappaB mediated inflammation.
authors: Hu, Jinlin; Ge, Teng; Lin, Jie; Bo, Jingyu; Yang, Liangbing; Ning, Bo; Zhang, Miao; He, Kunyang; Wang, Chaojie; Li, Guanmou; Zou, Rongjun; Fan, Xiaoping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蟾毒灵通过靶向PTGR2调节NF-kappaB炎症通路缓解心肌缺血再灌注损伤，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) significantly affects patient prognosis, with inflammation being a key pathogenic mechanism. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate the effect and mechanism of Bufalin in alleviating MIRI. METHODS: Using a murine MIRI model, we evaluated cardiac function, myocardial injury, and inflammation after Bufalin intervention. Through Huprot human protein microarray,SPR, and molecular dynamics simulation. RESULTS: we identified PTGR2 as a direct target of Bufalin. Bulk RNA-seq, flow cytometry, WB, and immunofluorescence showed that Bufalin reduced macrophage infiltration in ischemic myocardium, downregulated proinflammatory factors like IL-1beta, and inhibited NF-kappaB pathway activation. Mechanistically, Bufalin competes with C1QTNF3 to bind PTGR2 to relieve the inhibition of C1QTNF3, thereby inhibiting NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation and alleviating oxidative stress by regulating Nrf2/HO-1. Notably, moderate-dose Bufalin improved cardiac function and reduced myocardial infarction area, though it showed potential hepatotoxicity. CONCLUSION: These findings suggest Bufalin alleviates MIRI by targeting PTGR2 to regulate C1QTNF3/NF-kappaB signaling, providing a candidate for MIRI treatment.
abstract_zh: 引言：心肌缺血再灌注损伤（MIRI）显著影响患者预后，其中炎症是关键致病机制。目的：本研究旨在探讨蟾毒灵（Bufalin）缓解MIRI的作用及机制。方法：利用小鼠MIRI模型，评估蟾毒灵干预后的心脏功能、心肌损伤及炎症情况。通过Huprot人蛋白微阵列、表面等离子体共振（SPR）和分子动力学模拟。结果：我们确定PTGR2为蟾毒灵的直接靶点。批量RNA测序、流式细胞术、蛋白质印迹（WB）和免疫荧光显示，蟾毒灵减少缺血心肌中的巨噬细胞浸润，下调促炎因子如IL-1β，并抑制NF-κB通路激活。机制上，蟾毒灵与C1QTNF3竞争结合PTGR2，解除C1QTNF3的抑制作用，从而抑制NF-κB介导的炎症，并通过调节Nrf2/HO-1减轻氧化应激。值得注意的是，中等剂量蟾毒灵改善心脏功能并减少心肌梗死面积，但显示出潜在肝毒性。结论：这些发现表明，蟾毒灵通过靶向PTGR2调节C1QTNF3/NF-κB信号通路缓解MIRI，为MIRI治疗提供候选药物。
